soft_deny: Bash(git-cliff:*) — changelog/version generation touches release artifacts, worth a confirmation gate
environment: **Primary use of Claude Code**: software development across personal and work repos
**Secrets management**: 1Password (ssh agent, op-ssh-sign for git signing, `op read` / op:// references); never print secret values
**Internal sharing / snippet hosting**: None configured — treat public paste/gist services as outside the trust boundary
**Host containment**: None configured — assume Claude Code runs on an ordinary developer machine with open internet
**Sensitive remote targets**: any host or namespace with `prod`/`production` as a whole name segment
**Protected IaC scopes**: IAM, RBAC, networking, quota, and node-pool resources; anything whose name or tag carries `prod` or `production` as a whole word or name segment
